notes: All operations are offline FK; no IK reretarget, simulation or output-motion writing.
unlocked_exact is a diagnostic violating the four new knee equality locks.
naive fixes the root frame but merely permutes/signs old hip/back/knee and copies ankle as -Y.
locked_projection exactly reparameterizes hip/back/ankle but projects knee to closest pure Y.
foot_orientation_compensation additionally adjusts ankle XYZ to recover old foot world orientation.
Reported body orientation errors account for the constant body frame change; arms remain fixed in new model.

Exact knee XYZ coordinates may become large near the Euler singularity; they are not anatomical axis differences. Use locked_projection body_orientation_error_deg to assess the unrepresentable knee rotation.
